text:
Zoe: Quick note 9 - us-west-2 rack-4 showing repeated short-tail spikes and preemptions. Looks like egress/NVLINK coupling.
Ravi: seeing it. nvlink_tx and nic_tx burst right before evictions. Which tenants hit it first?
Zoe: a mix 14 several fractional dedicated and a couple of high-qps shared flows.
Marta: immediate mitigation idea: enable a short "grace-handoff" window on evictions (45s) so allocator gives stateful workloads time to checkpoint instead of immediate requeue. Also throttle best-effort batch on rack-4 hosts.
Ethan: agree. Grace-handoff reduces churn. We'll canary grace-handoff to 5% and apply eBPF pacer to the hosts.
Zoe: canary sounds good. Add metric "grace_handoff_reduction" and watch requeue_same_rack_count.
Ravi: commands:
```
# canary grace-handoff 5%
kubectl patch configmap allocator-policy -n fleet --type merge -p '{"data":{"grace_handoff_canary":"0.05","grace_handoff_s":"45"}}'
# throttle best-effort on rack-4
fleetctl run --hosts rack-4 "ebpf-qos --cgroup best-effort --egress 40% --tag incident-4129876543"
```
oncall-bot: eBPF QoS scheduled on 5 hosts in rack-4. Allocator canary patch queued.
Marta: I'll mute nvlink alert for 2m while we deploy to avoid alert storms.
Ethan: canary flipped to 5% and annotated: "grace-handoff-canary 5% us-west-2"
oncall-bot: Deploy annotation recorded by Ethan at 4129876602
Zoe: early signal: requeue_same_rack_count down ~30% after 6m, p95 down ~55ms. nvlink spikes lower but still present.
Ravi: good start. If grace-handoff reduces requeues, we can raise canary to 25% then 50% over 30/60 minute windows.
Marta: long-term we should add a host score that factors recent nvlink/pci stalls so allocator avoids hosts with recent IO storms for 1h. Filing INF-9997.
Ethan: follow-up: add a probe to track "handedoff_sessions_success" so we know if 45s is enough for checkpoint/flush.
Zoe: noted. If anyone sees error-rate for moved tenants spike >0.5% pause canary.
Ravi: keeping pacer for 20m, watching metrics. If stable at +20m, we'll bump to 25% and document in runbook.
Marta: adding runbook blurb now: grace-handoff -> eBPF pacer -> host-score avoid -> allocator canary progression.
Zoe: thanks team. I'll update the incident board at the 20m mark. :white_check_mark:
